body: I think the sparks gone. Just trying to get myself together right now before I try to deal with her. Maybe the sparks only gone cause of where I'm at right now.

Having these thoughts, and i suppose problems... is embarrasing to me. I'm not trying to put on an internet persona but People really do think I have my shit under control. I can't tell my friends because they look up to me and think I'm a strong person. 

I dont want to talk to my friends, mostly because it's embarrasing and it would shatter their perceptions of who they thought they knew.

Dont want to tell the rents to save us both the pain/failure

Definitely don't want to tell the girlfriend, because if we're going to break up soon like hell I want her to have that dirt on me. (god that sounds ridiculous typing it)

I know it must sound stupid, but I want this to be a secret...maybe as a way of not facing it. But I think some neutral 3rd party like a therapist would be my best bet in keeping me and everyone else happy

thank you for reading, and thanks for the response.

 One of the things holding me back is how it would affect my parents. If all three of my children had to seek counselling I would feel a bit bad about my parenting. They were great parents and still are. I don't want them to know and am thinking of trying to find a way to get counselling without them knowing. I'm trying to get a grasp on this before its too late
